It shows "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"the workspace repository against HEAD — or any two refs — and lets you act on what you see without l"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"epository against HEAD — or any two refs — and lets you act on what you see without leaving the tab:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- **Review first**: filterable file tree with status badges, side-by-side / unified / full-file diff"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"s, hunk folding, word-level change highlights, syntax coloring, and diff search across file names, d"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"iff text, and file content. Keyboard-first: `j`/`k` move between files, `/` focuses search.
- **Deci"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"de with history**: a lane commit graph with per-commit files and diffs, blame gutters, per-file hist"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"ory, and reading any file version from history.
- **Act under guard**: stage / unstage / discard per"},{"id":"p10s6","text":" file or per hunk, commit (plus amend, Ctrl+Enter), commit-and-push, and push; branches (create / sw"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"itch / rename / delete / merge / track remotes) with fetch and pull; history operations (reset / rev"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"ert / cherry-pick, per-commit actions from the graph); lightweight tags (create / delete / push); st"},{"id":"p10s9","text":"ash; and merge-conflict resolution (ours / theirs, continue / abort). Every write needs explicit con"},{"id":"p10s10","text":"firmation, destructive ones ask twice, and everything locks while the agent is running.
- **Close th"},{"id":"p10s11","text":"e loop**: comment on any diff line and drop it into the composer draft, mark files reviewed (auto-cl"},{"id":"p10s12","text":"eared when the file changes again), and keep comment drafts per workspace.
- **Preview files**: mark"},{"id":"p10s13","text":"down renders with the shell's own Markdown engine, HTML / images / SVG show inline, PDFs open sandbo"},{"id":"p10s14","text":"xed — a script-dependent HTML page gets a notice strip with an open-in-browser shortcut instead of s"},{"id":"p10s15","text":"itting black — every preview has a source view toggle, and office documents open in your external ap"},{"id":"p10s16","text":"ps from the tree's right-click menu.
- **Picture diffs**: image changes (PNG / JPG / GIF / WebP / BM"},{"id":"p10s17","text":"P / AVIF / ICO / SVG) render as pictures right inside the diff view — 2-up (side by side, or stacked"},{"id":"p10s18","text":" in unified), swipe, onion skin and a difference blend, with the source diff one click away."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Preferences (diff layout, default search scope, graph shape, matching, whitespace, syntax) live in t"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"he harness settings Plugins tab and sync instantly with the Review tab."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"From npm:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Or from a local tarball:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Requires DeepSeek Harness `0.1.2-rc.1` through `0.2.0-rc.1` (prerelease series are pinned one by one"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" in `peerDependencies`) and git on the host PATH. Outside a git repository the tab offers file brows"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"ing with one-click `git init` instead of the review workbench — never a blank screen. Display prefer"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"ences live in the configuration the harness serves for this plugin's entry: its own `.volatile()` fi"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"elds keyed by the profile entry id from `0.1.7-alpha.1` on, the Plugins page's entry for this plugin"},{"id":"p17s6","text":" from `0.1.6-alpha.2` on, or the settings modal's plugin cards before that."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Checks"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- **Host half**: an in-process cordis plugin serving a fenced prefix route for versioned API actions"},{"id":"p21s2","text":" over JSON (non-JSON bodies get 415, which also closes the classic no-cors write vectors). - **Client half**: a co"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"nversation-view slot component; the host route is optional — without it the tab says so instead of e"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"rroring.
- **Scale guards**: 20k-row render cap, 2 MiB per-file diff cap, 500-commit graph pages wit"},{"id":"p21s7","text":"h load-more, an 8 MiB streaming byte cap on the largest git answers plus a separate 8 MiB preview ca"},{"id":"p21s8","text":"p (both truncate instead of buffering whole), and exact-count probing within a 32 MiB per-status bud"},{"id":"p21s9","text":"get.
